description: This file provides utility functions for resolving and spawning pnpm package manager commands across different platforms. It includes logic for handling command escaping on Windows and abstracting platform-specific command invocation details.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Determines the correct command, arguments, and platform-specific options to execute pnpm, considering custom paths and environment variables.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a specification object with command, args, and options for spawning the pnpm process.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Executes the pnpm process spawn based on the parameters provided.
